visualCharacteristics.purpose: Portrait photo cards with an icon badge, short heading and a CTA button
visualCharacteristics.layout: 1/2/3 columns at mobile/600px/900px; 4:5 photo with icon badge top-left; CTA pinned to card bottom

contentPattern.structure: cell 1: photo plus optional second image or :icon: for the badge; cell 2: heading or text and a CTA link
contentPattern.sourceDescription: Three look-alike cards: portrait photo with icon overlay, heading, CTA (What is Obesity / Download the guide here / Speak to a doctor)

usage: Getting-help steps on the home page.
reuseGuidance: Use for 2-3 photo-led entry points that each lead to one action.
